title: Mistral Small 3 Release
summary: Mistral AI introduced Mistral Small 3 on January 30, 2025 as a latency-optimized 24B-parameter model released under the Apache 2.0 license.
significance: A dated release milestone for Mistral AI's open-weight model line, with pretrained and instruction-tuned checkpoints made available under Apache 2.0.

verification.note: Mistral AI's first-party announcement is dated January 30, 2025 and states that Mistral Small 3 is a latency-optimized 24B-parameter model released under Apache 2.0, with pretrained and instruction-tuned checkpoints. Mistral's official model documentation independently records January 30, 2025 and model identifier mistral-small-2501.
